title.narrative: Land Productivity Project

description.narrative: Togo Threshold - Land Productivity Project: The objectives of this project are to: (1) expand access to formalized land by identifying and legitimizing customary land rights, (2) move the legitimized rights into the formal system, (3) improve the formal system so that it effectively protects legitimate land rights, and (4) expand inclusive access to land by ensuring that recognition of women's rights, already recognized in formal law, are fully incorporated into practice.
